verdict.rationale: Retell documents one latency-tuning lever: transcription mode, which trades latency against accuracy through interim results and endpointing settings. It also measures latency in its analytics dashboard and AI QA scoring. The pack contains no published end-to-end voice latency figures (e.g., ms response times) and no broader tuning guide covering LLM, TTS, telephony or turn-taking, so the speed claims are only thinly backed. Missing for 10: published end-to-end latency benchmarks or numbers, holistic latency tuning guidance beyond transcription mode, independent latency measurements.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented end-to-end voice latency numbers or tuning guidance backing the platform's speed claims

citations.quote: Real time transcription is often a trade off between latency and accuracy.
optimize for speed: uses the latest interim results with a low endpointing setting... optimize for accuracy: uses the results with a higher endpointing setting
Build custom Retell analytics dashboards to track call and chat metrics like success rate, latency, cost, and concurrency
